baseAnalysis: Existing current base bookings/resources/occupancy/conflicts/completions/invoices/payments/allocations/attention/revisions/reviewHistory/totalsByCurrency/summary unchanged; bookings additionally marine cost/quoted/billable fields. Each extra table row has key and sourceLine/sourceEndLine and review.

semantics.time: status running|final|voided. Entry correction uses exact predecessor IDs, strictly increasing version and recorded_at; observed_at>=recorded_at. Running retains blank end and unknown accrued duration/cost. Final elapsed seconds minus explicit break_seconds. Cost and bill rates independent; blank means unknown, zero is a supplied zero. Round each entry to minor units, half up, explicit duration seconds*hourly rate/3600. The core never chooses wages or tax. Original raw values preserved.
semantics.materials: status final|voided; quantity_milli integer nonnegative thousandths of declared unit; cost and bill rates independent blank/zero semantics. Round each entry half up quantity_milli*rate/1000. Original predecessor chain preserved.
semantics.selection: Current version is greatest recorded/version that is observed by asOf; each retained version remains individually inspectable. Original job revision stays bound. Job, worker and currency cannot silently change within an entry chain. Late versions do not rewrite original handover/submission membership.
semantics.handover: Explicit time/material/media version IDs from same job, single explicit recipient and customer_notes. customerReport exports only selected customer-safe fields (durations/descriptions/quantity/unit/media references and notes), excludes internal cost/rates/review/authorization/full archive. Each preview names retained versions. Events sent|delivered|failed|bounced|acknowledged; latest occurred transport separate from acknowledgement.
semantics.weeks: Explicit offset-bearing start/end and boundary_basis; selected time-version IDs bind technician and week, full observed source remains. status events approved|rejected|withdrawn; approval independent accounting. Changed current time after submission marks stale comparison, preserving approved historical duration and leaving new version for reapproval. No implicit split at week boundary.
semantics.accounting: request.kind invoice|timesheet; subject exact invoice_id or submission_id; supplied request SHA256 retained, never manufactured from differently scoped data. Events requested|succeeded|failed|unknown. External result is separate from accounting-source invoice/payment amounts; succeeded never creates receipt or revenue. Unknown outcome remains reviewable. This standalone workbench performs no remote mutation.
semantics.costs: Job known cost subtotal is sum current final priced labour/material. Any missing rate or running time makes total unknown; retain known subtotal and unknown count. Quote minus actual cost is a comparison only, separately invoice outstanding and unallocated credit.
semantics.chronology: Use observed_at as availability cutoff and occurred/recorded time for event sequence; later observation of older occurrence does not overwrite later outcome. Conflicting same-effective event states reject ambiguous source. All source CSV bytes/BOM/newlines preserved.

proposedCourse: At least two boats/three jobs; revised quote, corrected offline technician time, one ongoing timer, material return via void/version, explicit missing cost comparison, original selected handover and corrected second handover, failed/delayed delivery/ack, original approved week then changed time requires distinct new submission, accounting uncertain then actual succeeded with invoice still unpaid, later explicit partial payment/refund. Full unfinished source inputs and accepted editions survive browser/native handoff.
